description:
Hide any app window from screen sharing and recording at the Windows capture level.

HideMyShare hides any app window from screen sharing and recording — at the Windows capture level, so protected windows don't get blurred, they disappear from the stream entirely while staying fully visible to you.

Built for remote workers who keep personal chats open during meetings. It auto re-protects new windows every second, hides IME candidate bars, supports custom rules for any app, and runs in 20 languages. Works with Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, OBS.

No account, no telemetry; everyday use is fully offline after a one-time activation. Free 7-day trial with all features; lifetime license with 7-day money-back guarantee.
